developments: Bitcoin slipped overnight, falling from about $60,260 at the evening edition to a low near $58,650 on Kraken before 06:00 UK, and traded near $58,920 at 06:30 UK, down about 2.2%.
ZEC dipped to about $760 in the early hours, then recovered to near $784 at 06:30 UK, little changed from about $790 last night.
Chainflip said the attacker in Saturday's vault hack took about $12 million, not the $4.86 million first reported, and offered a 10% bounty if the rest is returned by 18:38 UK on Monday.
briefing.changed: Saturday's rebound has partly faded. Bitcoin lost the $60,000 mark overnight on thin weekend trading, with no new market-moving news found to explain it, but it remains above the old $57,700 summer low.
briefing.question: Was the overnight slip just thin weekend trading, or the start of a retest of Friday's $55,130 low before US markets reopen?
briefing.watch: US stock futures reopen at about 23:00 UK tonight, then the US open at 14:30 UK on Monday. The next 🔴 event is the Fed decision on Wednesday 9 December at 19:00 UK.

lead.headline: Bitcoin slips back below $60,000 in quiet overnight trading
lead.standfirst: Bitcoin gave back part of Saturday's rebound in thin Asian-hours trading, while the Chainflip hack was revealed to be more than twice as large as first thought.
body: Bitcoin traded near $58,920 on Kraken at 06:30 UK time on Sunday, Kraken data showed, about 2.2% below its level at 21:30 UK on Saturday. Most of the fall came between 02:00 and 06:00 UK, when it touched a low near $58,650.

No single piece of news was found to explain the move. CoinDesk had reported on Saturday that Bitcoin bounced more than 9% from Friday's two-year low of $55,130, and that Glassnode said the sell-off had cleared the largest cluster of futures liquidation levels, between $59,000 and $62,000.
Zcash dipped to about $760 in the early hours before recovering to near $784, according to Kraken.

Cointelegraph reported that Chainflip Labs confirmed an attacker took about $12 million from its vaults on Saturday, including about 123 BTC, up from the $4.86 million first reported. Chainflip offered a 10% bounty if the rest is returned by 18:38 UK on Monday, and FLIP fell about 43% in 24 hours, citing CoinGecko.
US stock futures reopen at about 23:00 UK on Sunday, and US stocks and spot bitcoin ETFs trade again from 14:30 UK on Monday.

headline: A quiet night: Bitcoin slipped about 2% to near $58,920 and ZEC held near $784. Chainflip's hack grew to about $12 million; the test is US markets reopening tonight and Monday.
spoken: Cryptonaire Post, morning edition, Sunday the twenty second of November. A quiet night, but Bitcoin has slipped back below sixty thousand dollars. It is near fifty eight thousand nine hundred dollars, down about two percent since last night, with no clear news behind the move. Zcash dipped to about seven hundred and sixty dollars overnight and is back near seven hundred and eighty four. The Chainflip hack is now put at about twelve million dollars. Nothing is scheduled today. US stock futures reopen around eleven tonight, and US markets open at half past two on Monday afternoon. The next big event is the Fed decision on the ninth of December at seven in the evening. Information only, not advice.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips back below $60,000 overnight
stories.why: Kraken showed Bitcoin falling from about $60,260 at 21:30 UK to a low near $58,650 before 06:00 UK, and near $58,920 at 06:30 UK, down about 2.2%. The new evidence is that the weekend rebound has partly faded, though price is still above the old $57,700 summer low and well above Friday's $55,130 low.

note.read: A slow overnight drift on thin volume looks like the rebound running out of buyers rather than fresh selling pressure.
note.alt: Weekend price moves often reverse once US investors return; the slip may mean little.
note.change: A fall back below about $57,700 before or after the US reopening would point to a retest of Friday's low.

stories.title: Chainflip hack put at $12 million, with a 10% bounty offer
stories.why: Cointelegraph reported that Chainflip Labs confirmed the attacker took about 122.86 BTC, 520 ETH, 3.25 million USDC and 758,000 USDT, about $12 million in all, up from the $4.86 million first reported. Chainflip offered a 10% bounty if the rest is returned by 18:38 UK on Monday 23 November, said it traced the attack to Tornado Cash funding on 11 November, and FLIP fell about 43% in 24 hours. It is a reminder of the risk in cross-chain swap services.

note.read: Too small to move Bitcoin itself, but a sign that confidence in cross-chain bridges is being tested after two incidents in a day.
note.alt: A quick return of funds under the bounty would close the story with little lasting effect.
note.change: A larger loss figure, or news that the key exposure affects other protocols, would raise its importance.

stories.title: ZEC dips to $760 and recovers to near $784
stories.why: Kraken showed ZEC falling to about $760 between 02:00 and 04:00 UK alongside Bitcoin, then recovering to near $784 at 06:30 UK, against about $790 last night. No new ZEC news overnight.

stories.title: Kalshi faces Monday hearing on New York order
stories.why: The Block reported that a federal judge on Friday denied the CFTC's second emergency bid to block New York's case against prediction market Kalshi, and a New York state judge is set to hear the state's restraining order request at 16:30 UK on Monday. Kalshi says the order would shut its exchange for every customer; New York says it would not. A test of how far US states can police federally regulated crypto-adjacent markets.

stories.title: ETF outflows still the open question for Monday
stories.why: CoinDesk put last week's net withdrawals from US spot bitcoin ETFs at about $1.1 billion. Nothing new until US markets trade again from 14:30 UK on Monday.

investigating: What drove Bitcoin's overnight slip? Evidence: futures open interest, funding rates and liquidation totals for 02:00 to 06:00 UK.
Will Chainflip's attacker take the bounty? Evidence: on-chain returns to Chainflip addresses before 18:38 UK on Monday.
Will Monday's US session confirm or undo the weekend? Evidence: Nasdaq futures from 23:00 UK tonight, then Monday's ETF flows.
